name: partoska
description: Run Partoska photo-sharing events: create events, moderate guest uploads, pick favorites, and share via QR codes and printable cards

interface.longDescription: Partoska collects photos from guests at weddings, birthdays, and parties through an invite link or QR code. Use it to create and update events, browse and upload photos, moderate guest uploads, pick favorites, check photos before an event goes public, and share via invite links, QR codes, and printable cards. It can also design event assets such as posters, collages, and recap stories.
defaultPrompt: Show me the latest photos from my event
Create an event for Saturday and give me the QR code
Moderate the pending photos at my party
